question: Provide the daily weather data for Rochester from January 1 to March 31, 2019, including temperature (in Celsius), precipitation (in centimeters), and wind speed (in meters per second). For each variable, calculate the 8-day moving average (including the current day and the previous 7 days). Also, calculate the difference between the moving average on each day and the moving averages for the previous 1 to 8 days (i.e., lag1 to lag8). The result should include: The daily values for temperature, precipitation, and wind speed.The 8-day moving averages for each variable. The differences between the moving averages for each of the previous 1 to 8 days (e.g., the difference between today's moving average and the moving average from 1 day ago, from 2 days ago, and so on). Round all values to one decimal place. The data should be ordered by date, starting from January 9, 2019.
sql:
-- Final query with all required columns
WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) as date_str,
    SAFE_CAST((temp - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0 AS FLOAT64) as temp_c,
    SAFE_CAST(prcp * 2.54 AS FLOAT64) as prcp_cm,
    SAFE_CAST(CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) * 0.514444 AS FLOAT64) as wdsp_ms,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)) as day_num
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019` 
  WHERE stn = '725290' AND year = '2019' AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
),
with_moving_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    date_str,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wdsp_ms,
    day_num,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY day_num ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) as temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY day_num ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) as prcp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wdsp_ms) OVER (ORDER BY day_num ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) as wdsp_ma8
  FROM base_data
)
SELECT 
  date_str,
  ROUND(temp_c, 1) as temp_c,
  ROUND(prcp_cm, 1) as prcp_cm,
  ROUND(wdsp_ms, 1) as wdsp_ms,
  temp_ma8,
  prcp_ma8,
  wdsp_ma8,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as temp_lag1,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as prcp_lag1,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as wdsp_lag1,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as temp_lag2,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as prcp_lag2,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as wdsp_lag2,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as temp_lag3,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as prcp_lag3,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as wdsp_lag3,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as temp_lag4,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as prcp_lag4,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as wdsp_lag4,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as temp_lag5,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as prcp_lag5,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as wdsp_lag5,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as temp_lag6,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as prcp_lag6,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as wdsp_lag6,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as temp_lag7,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as prcp_lag7,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as wdsp_lag7,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as temp_lag8,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as prcp_lag8,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY day_num), 1) as wdsp_lag8
FROM with_moving_avg
WHERE day_num >= 9
ORDER BY day_num

  stn  STRING  -- Cloud - GSOD NOAA
  wban  STRING  -- WBAN number where applicable--this is the historical "Weather Bureau Air Force Navy" number - with WBAN being the acronym
  year  STRING  -- The year
  mo  STRING  -- The month
  da  STRING  -- The day
  temp  FLOAT64  -- Mean temperature for the day in degrees Fahrenheit to tenths. Missing = 9999.9
  count_temp  INT64  -- Number of observations used in calculating mean temperature
  dewp  FLOAT64  -- Mean dew point for the day in degreesm Fahrenheit to tenths.  Missing = 9999.9
  count_dewp  INT64  -- Number of observations used in calculating mean dew point
  slp  FLOAT64  -- Mean sea level pressure for the day in millibars to tenths. Missing = 9999.9
  count_slp  INT64  -- Number of observations used in calculating mean sea level pressure
  stp  FLOAT64  -- Mean station pressure for the day in millibars to tenths. Missing = 9999.9
  count_stp  INT64  -- Number of observations used in calculating mean station pressure
  visib  FLOAT64  -- Mean visibility for the day in miles to tenths.  Missing = 999.9
  count_visib  INT64  -- Number of observations used in calculating mean visibility
  wdsp  STRING  -- Mean wind speed for the day in knots to tenths. Missing = 999.9
  count_wdsp  STRING  -- Number of observations used in calculating mean wind speed
  mxpsd  STRING  -- Maximum sustained wind speed reported for the day in knots to tenths. Missing = 999.9
  gust  FLOAT64  -- Maximum wind gust reported for the day in knots to tenths. Missing = 999.9
  max  FLOAT64  -- Maximum temperature reported during the day in Fahrenheit to tenths--time of max temp report varies by country and region, so this will sometimes not be the max for the calendar day. Missing = 9999.9
  flag_max  STRING  -- Blank indicates max temp was taken from the explicit max temp report and not from the 'hourly' data. * indicates max temp was  derived from the hourly data (i.e., highest hourly or synoptic-reported temperature)
  min  FLOAT64  -- Minimum temperature reported during the day in Fahrenheit to tenths--time of min temp report varies by country and region, so this will sometimes not be the min for the calendar day. Missing = 9999.9
